howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Six mechanisms. One crown.
howItWorks.rankingDesc: Products are ranked by their cumulative bid amount. The highest bidder in each category is the King.
howItWorks.biddingDesc: Place a bid to get on the board. Increase your bid anytime to climb higher.
howItWorks.randomDesc: Every hour, 3 random products are featured regardless of their bid. Equal exposure for all.
howItWorks.clicksDesc: The most visited products over the last 7 days. Real interest, not just money.
howItWorks.gemsDesc: Products that have been on the board for 72+ hours but haven't gotten much exposure yet.
howItWorks.dethronedDesc: When someone outbids you, you get notified. Defend your crown or let it go.

rules.title: Rules & Transparency
rules.subtitle: Positions are determined by public bids. No backroom deals.
rules.rule1: Rankings are determined solely by cumulative bid amounts
rules.rule2: All bids are final and non-refundable
rules.rule3: Minimum initial bid is $5, minimum increase is $5
rules.rule4: Products must be real, functional, and publicly accessible
rules.rule6: We reserve the right to remove listings that violate our guidelines
